mīror

mīror, mīrārī, mīrātus sum

verb, first conjugation, deponent · Conjugation on Wiktionary

wonder at, marvel at; admire; be surprised, amazed; wonder (what, why, where)

In this lexicon

  • admire

    also used · classical

  • be surprised

    the recommended word · classical · Traupman 388

  • wonder

    the recommended word · classical · Ter. Eun. 290: mīror quid ex Pīraeeō abierit; Caes. BG 1.32.2: ejus reī quae causa esset mīrātus; Traupman 111, 408

Examples

  • accēpī tuam epistulam vacillantibus litterulīs, nec mīrum tam gravī morbō.

    I have had your letter in shaky handwriting, and no wonder, after so serious an illness.Cic. Fam. 16.15.2
